items.title: Genuine nonlinear common-noise coupling and raw transport cost

source.anchor: Theorem4.5 proof, HTML529-545; Proposition4.7 (4.13), HTML590-615; shared raw-infimum prerequisite
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu, Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS explicit transport prerequisite/actual-kernel interface, not the full local-error or main result.

items.statement: The true randomized output laws map(Phi,mu×Gamma) and map(Phi,nu×Gamma) obey T_c(output_mu,output_nu)<=A T_c(mu,nu). Here T_c is the raw Kantorovich infimum over actual couplings. Input/output costs may be infinite and no optimizer or finite moments are assumed.
assumptions: E is a normed additive Borel group with second-countable topology. These topological/algebraic conditions are exposed API requirements of the reused shared marginal interface, not hidden moment or optimizer assumptions. State and noise use this same space.
Phi:E×E->E and the extended nonnegative cost c:E×E->ENNReal are jointly measurable. The noise Gamma and both input laws mu,nu are probability measures. 0<A<infinity in extended reals.

For every x,y,zeta, c(Phi(x,zeta),Phi(y,zeta))<=A c(x,y). This is the explicit general lifting premise; the actual source algorithm consumer proves it from its genuine normalized potential, not a supplied kernel certificate.

formulae.label: Genuine randomized law and raw transport

bindings.boundary: Actual Gaussian exact-gradient numerical K at the explicit normalized global C2 curvature interface. Actual f=V_eta smoothing/C2/curvature remains separate. No target invariance/stationarity, numerical target bias, stochastic Khat/Kbar, local errors/history/expected query cost, Wp/proxy-warmness/initialization, PBPS or either complete main/composition result. TV proximity does not transfer unbounded cost.

items.title: Actual Gaussian numerical kernel: integrated law and source transport contraction

source.anchor: Proposition4.7 (4.13) and Theorem4.5 common-noise proof, HTML529-545,590-615
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu, Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS explicit transport prerequisite/actual-kernel interface, not the full local-error or main result.

items.statement: Construct a Markov K whose law at every z is Gamma.map(zeta -> Phi(z,zeta)). For all probability mu,nu, K composed with each input equals the actual pushforward Phi#(input×Gamma), and W_M²(Kmu,Knu)<=(1-h/(65536kappa))² W_M²(mu,nu). This is the actual deterministic exact-gradient Gaussian numerical kernel, not an arbitrary supplied contracting kernel and not an invariant-target theorem.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including zero dimension. kappa>=1, f:E->R is globally C2 and its actual nested second derivative satisfies (2kappa)^-1||v||²<=D²f(z)[v,v]<=||v||² for every z,v. Producing the actual source f=V_eta remains open.

J>=2,h>0; t_j=h(1-cos(j*pi/(J-1)))/2, cardinal ell_j, and omega_ij=integral_0^t_i(t_i-s)ell_j(s)ds, b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s)ds,c_j=integral_0^h(h-s)ell_j(s)ds are the actual coefficients. Lambda=sup_[0,h] sum_j |ell_j| and actual hLambda<=1/(65536kappa).

a=exp(-h/2),sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)); P0=a p+sigma zeta0, Y0_j=x+t_jP0, Y1_i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij gradient f(Y0_j), Phi=(x+hP0-sum_j c_j gradient f(Y1_j),a(P0-sum_j b_j gradient f(Y1_j))+sigma zeta1). Gamma=standard Gaussian E product standard Gaussian E, with independent refresh vectors.

Both input laws mu,nu are arbitrary probability laws on phase space; their source quadratic transport may be infinite. Q_kappa(x,p)=((2kappa)^-1+1/2)||x||²+inner(x,p)+||p||², c_kappa(z,zprime)=ofReal Q_kappa(z-zprime), and W_M²=T_c_kappa. Source Q is retained, not the ordinary product max norm.
